data.description:
## Problem

When hovering the mouse cursor over a work-item row in the Herdr worklist that has an associated agent-pane, the user has no quick way to see the work-item metadata. The metadata panel at the bottom only shows info for the **selected** row.

## Solution

Add a hover tooltip overlay in the footer area that shows essential work-item metadata for any row the mouse hovers over, when that row has an associated agent-pane. Pressing `Esc` closes the tooltip until the mouse exits and re-enters the pane boundaries.

### Displayed Metadata

For a work item with an associated agent-pane, the tooltip shows:

| Field | Source |
|---|---|
| ID | `workItem.id` |
| Title | `workItem.title` |
| Command | Stored command dispatched to the pane (e.g. `/skill:implement WL-123`) |
| Priority | `workItem.priority` |
| Type | `workItem.issueType` |
| Risk | `workItem.risk` |
| Effort | `workItem.effort` |
| Start Time | `AgentPaneEntry.recordedAt` (ISO timestamp) |

### Data Model Changes

Currently, `AgentPaneEntry` in `packages/herdr/src/agent-tracker.ts` stores only `workItemId`, `paneId`, and `recordedAt`. The **command** field must be added:

```typescript
interface AgentPaneEntry {
  workItemId: string;
  paneId: string;
  recordedAt: string;
  /** The command dispatched to this pane (e.g. "/skill:implement WL-123"). */
  command?: string;
}
```

### Mouse Hover Handling

The worklist already has SGR mouse tracking (`consumeMouseChunk`, `mapMouseToAction`). Currently, motion events (button & 32) return `null` and are inert. The tooltip feature extends this:

- Track mouse motion events to determine which row the cursor is over
- Map the y-coordinate to a row index via `mapListRowToIndex`
- Look up the work item in `items` at that index
- Check if the work item has an associated pane via `agentTracker.getPaneId(workItemId)`
- If yes, render the tooltip overlay in the footer area
- Pressing `Esc` dismisses the tooltip; it reappears on next mouse enter into the list area

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Hover tooltip renders** — When the mouse cursor is over a work-item row with an associated agent-pane, a tooltip appears showing all 8 metadata fields above (ID, Title, Command, Priority, Type, Risk, Effort, Start Time).
2. **Esc dismisses** — Pressing `Esc` closes the tooltip immediately. The tooltip reappears the next time the mouse re-enters the list area over a pane-associated row.
3. **Only pane rows** — Rows without an associated agent-pane (no icon) show no tooltip on hover.
4. **Command stored** — The command string (`/skill:*`, `/intake`, `/plan`, `/prompt:`) is persisted in the `agent-panes.json` state file when recording the pane association.
5. **No regression** — Existing mouse interactions (click, double-click, wheel navigation) continue to work correctly. Motion events that would trigger the tooltip are consumed and do not leak to keyboard handlers.
5. **Data migration** — The `agent-panes.json` reader handles entries that lack the new `command` field (backward compatible).
6. **Tests** — Unit tests cover: tooltip state machine (show/dismiss/re-show), motion-to-row mapping, metadata formatting, backward-compatible `agent-panes.json` parsing.
data.title: Herdr worklist: hover tooltip on agent-pane rows showing work-item metadata
